# crongx

crongx inspects a schedule of timed runs for collisions on a shared resource,
duplicate names and negative times. Part of gxkit; the inspect contract (stable
codes, exit codes, a storyboard) is shared.

- Install/run: uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/crongx" crongx inspect sched.py
- Write: a Python file building crongx.Schedule(runs=[crongx.Run("backup", start=0, duration=3600, resource="disk")]); or RUNS / NAME.
- A run is Run(name, start, duration, resource); a run holds [start, start+duration).
- crongx inspect sched.py — exit 1 on any error; --json; --no-storyboard; -o name.png.
- Codes: overlap (error), duplicate-run (error), negative-start (error), negative-duration (error), non-finite-time (error), zero-duration (info), no-runs (info).
